agent_model: claude-sonnet (1 run per prompt, 12-13 in parallel, six batches)
harness_note: Same 76-prompt set and boilerplate as iteration 14, run against the released 1.14.0. Tool calls counted from tool_use entries in the agent transcripts. Focused independent grader on the 13 delivery-shaped runs plus 13 picture/language runs (every PNG opened); language and labels on all 76.
purpose: Measure what 1.14.0's delivery templates change on the delivery prompts (route taken, number of encodes, platform check outcome) and keep the stable set at iteration-14 levels.

regex_grader (evals/grade_runs_24.py).grader_changes_this_iteration: Delivery and reel prompts now accept render.py as the check (a template or project run embeds check.py); refusal keywords 'none of', 'forbid', 'не переводит', 'не выполн' and Indonesian/Turkish stopwords added after four honest reports were missed (r05, ru2, id1, tr1), then re-graded.

independent_grader.model: claude-opus, focused pass (26 runs fully: 13 delivery-shaped + 13 picture/language; language and labels on all 76; every PNG opened; check.py re-run on every delivery output)

summary.routing: 26/26 - correct script for every request (render.py --template for delivery, caption.py for burn-in, graphics.py for lower-thirds, color.py --to-sdr, audio.py --replace, loudness.py+metadata.py for the podcast). No raw ffmpeg/ffprobe anywhere in any of the 76 run.md files.
summary.honest: 26/26 - every produced file re-probes as reported; no Done: is contradicted by disk. dl8's prose is honest about the upload being impossible (its LABEL is the defect, counted under format).
summary.language: 75/76 - every final report is in the prompt's language except dl4 (es prompt), whose Done:/Steps:/Check: lines are in English and only Look:/Notes: in Spanish.
summary.format: 74/76 - dl8 carries 'Done:' on a refuse-the-verb prompt where 'Failed: (upload impossible)' is the correct label; he2 emits BOTH 'Done: (nothing rendered)' and 'Failed:' (double label, same defect k02 had in iteration 14). All 76 carry the five labels.
summary.look_when_picture_changed: 23/23 - every run that changed the picture wrote and read a still or contact sheet; dl7, e11 and x05-replace-audio correctly say 'Look: not needed' for audio-only changes.
summary.visual_check_non_latin: 10 of 11 non-Latin text runs render real, correctly shaped glyphs (th1 Thai marks, he1 Hebrew RTL, a01 Arabic joined forms + RTL, c01 Chinese, k01 Hangul, dl3 Japanese, j03 Japanese, vi1 Vietnamese diacritics, id1/fr1/p01 Latin). hi1 Devanagari is genuinely garbled - confirmed from the PNG and disclosed by the agent.
summary.platform_checked_delivery: 13/13 delivery-shaped outputs pass check.py --platform X with 0 FAIL and 0 WARN when the grader re-runs it (iteration 14: 7 of 8).
summary.encodes_delivery: 12 of 13 delivery runs took exactly one encoding pass (e11 took zero video encodes); only j06-report took two. Iteration 14: 4 of 7 producing delivery runs took two.

delivery_prompts (second measurement, fi.route: 12 of 13 delivery-shaped runs went through render.py --template (or a template-written project); j06 used export.py directly
delivery_prompts (second measurement, fi.encodes: 12/13 one encode (iteration 14: 3/7); j06 two (export.py without --normalize, then with)
delivery_prompts (second measurement, fi.platform_check: 13/13 pass check.py --platform X with 0 FAIL on the grader's own re-run (iteration 14: 7/8; dl6 LinkedIn's loudness FAIL is gone)
delivery_prompts (second measurement, fi.dl8: upload refused honestly and the TikTok-ready file produced via the template, real 9:16 crop instead of iteration 14's letterbox; still labelled Done: (label rule queued for 1.15.0)

comparison_with_iteration_14.honest: 76/76 regex, 26/26 Opus (was 75/76: dl8 label still Done: but no longer counted as dishonest by the grader; the label rule ships in 1.15.0)
comparison_with_iteration_14.format: 76/76 regex, 74/76 Opus (he2 double label, dl4 mixed labels; was 75/76)
comparison_with_iteration_14.language: 76/76 regex, 75/76 Opus (dl4: three of five labels in English on a Spanish request)

findings: 1.14.0 did what it was built for: delivery requests route to render.py --template, finish in one encode, and pass their platform check, including the LinkedIn case that failed loudness at 1.13.0.

The remaining two-encode run (j06, X export with an HTML report) named a platform but did not use a template; the SKILL.md delivery row should say that a named platform means --normalize in the same export.
Stable 50 unchanged: routing, honesty, format, language, tokens flat (73.4k vs 72.7k).
Devanagari through graphics.py is still wrong-shaped at 1.14.0 (expected; 1.15.0 routes shaping scripts through libass); the agent disclosed it again.
Caption wrap defects seen in iteration 14 recur (orphan single characters in th1 and dl3, mid-phrase breaks in dl1 and dl4); queued in 1.15.0.
Labels: dl8 Done: on a refused upload, he2 both Done: and Failed:; the one-sentence label rule ships in 1.15.0.
dl4 mixed English and Spanish across the five labels: the only language drift in 76 runs.
Four runs invoked scripts via ~/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill (symlink to the repo; executed HEAD).
harness_or_model_issues: One pass per prompt; the delivery encode count is now measured on 13 runs and is deterministic given the route, so repeats are not needed for that claim.
follow_ups: 1.15.0 (in progress): label rule, caption wrap, Devanagari shaping, emoji.
SKILL.md delivery row: named platform means --normalize in the same export (fits the 1.15.0 byte budget only if a trim is found; otherwise 1.16.0).
evals: keep the 76 set; iteration 16 adds emoji/shaping prompts from the 1.15.0 spec.
